-- GENOME SAMPLES (AX1)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS genome_samples (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  sample_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  plant_latin_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  population_code VARCHAR(50),
  region VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  collection_method ENUM('pollen', 'fallen_leaf', 'seed', 'tissue', 'herbarium_clip', 'other') NOT NULL,
  non_destructive BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  date_collected DATE,
  storage ENUM('silica_gel', '-20C', '-80C', 'LN2', 'room_temp', 'unknown') DEFAULT 'unknown',
  permit_ref VARCHAR(100),
  metadata JSON,
  notes TEXT,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX1_GENOMIC_CONSERVATION',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX gs_plant_idx (plant_latin_name),
  INDEX gs_region_idx (region)
);

-- GENOME SEQUENCES (AX1)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS genome_sequences (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  sequence_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  sample_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  gene_target VARCHAR(100),
  sequence_type ENUM('whole_genome', 'transcriptome', 'amplicon', 'targeted') DEFAULT 'targeted',
  platform VARCHAR(100),
  coverage INT,
  quality_score INT,
  accession_number VARCHAR(50),
  deposit_date DATE,
  data_file VARCHAR(500),
  notes TEXT,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'AX1_GENOMIC_CONSERVATION',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX gseq_sample_idx (sample_id)
);
